summary: Analyze company financial statements with ratio definitions, period comparisons, and caveats.
intents: analyze this company's income statement and balance sheet
calculate margins and leverage from the annual report
compare this year's results with last year
extract key figures from the 10-K PDF
prerequisites: the financial statements or an authoritative public filing
reporting periods, currency, accounting basis, and company context
verify: Each ratio shows its formula and the source line items
Periods compared use the same accounting basis, or differences are noted
Conclusions are framed as analysis, not investment advice
